IF THE BALANCE OF THE PURCHASE PRICE IS TO BE FINANCED, BIDDER MUST PRESENT AT SALE PRE-APPROVAL DOCUMENTATION FROM AN INSTITUTION REGULATED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF BANKING AND INSURANCE OR FEDERAL BANKING AGENCY AS DEFINED IN THE NEW JERSEY RESIDENTIAL MORTGAGE LENDING ACT. THOSE PERMITTED TO PAY THREE- AND ONE-HALF PERCENT DEPOSIT (3.5%) SHALL BE THE FOLLOWING IN ORDER OF PRIORITY: 1. THE FORECLOSED UPON DEFENDANT, THE FORECLOSED UPON DEFENDANT’S NEXT OF KIN OR TENANT, MEETING THE ABOVE REQUIREMENTS, SHALL HAVE RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL TO PURCHASE THE PROPERTY; (only available for the initial sale unless the sale is delayed) 2.
